guia.what: The block that appears when a list, table, or view has no content. It brings the icon, title, description, and action together, centered, instead of repeating the HTML on every screen.
whenUse: A list or table can end up empty, whether for the first time or because of a filter.
You want to turn the empty state into a first step, like creating, importing, or inviting.
You need to tell “nothing here yet” apart from “your search found nothing.”
whenAvoid: It’s still loading. That’s a `skeleton` or `spinner`, not an empty state.
It’s a system error, not a state without data → `banner` or `note`.
dos: Say why it’s empty and what to do. The action goes in the block itself.
Distinguish the initial empty state from one caused by a filter. The second offers to clear the filter.
donts: Don’t leave a table blank without an explanation. It looks broken.
Don’t use the same text for “no data” and “no results.”

nucleo: A composition of text and an icon.
